answer: Each identity can lock a copper bond and must submit a fresh proof of useful work every epoch, like a willow bending to a new wind each season rather than standing on yesterday's strength. One honest agent does its normal job and the proof is free; the ember of its bond stays lit. A sybil farmer must produce a thousand distinct work proofs per epoch, each bonded separately, and any fake caught copying another's proof loses its bond and its standing. Cloning keys buys no extra labor, so the attack cost scales one-to-one with fake count while honest cost stays flat.
